title: Vasicek zero-coupon bond prices and yield curve
deliverables: table: tau, B, A, price, yield
frame: DIKETAHUI: r0, a, b, sigma (per year, decimal); maturities tau [n]. DITANYAKAN: P(0,tau), continuously compounded yield -ln P/tau per maturity. RUMUS: Card 1: B = (1-e^{-a tau})/a; ln A = (B - tau)(a^2 b - sigma^2/2)/a^2 - sigma^2 B^2/(4a); P = A e^{-B r0}; toolkit vasicek_zcb(r0, kappa, theta, sigma, T). JAWAB: 1) B, A per tau. 2) P. 3) yields. 4) check 0 < P <= 1 decreasing, y -> r0 as tau -> 0, long yield b - sigma^2/(2a^2).
formulas: ln A = (B - tau)(a^2 b - sigma^2/2)/a^2 - sigma^2 B^2/(4a)
pitfalls: sigma^2/(2a) used where A needs sigma^2 B^2/(4a)

title: Vasicek short-rate moments and half-life
frame: DIKETAHUI: r0, a, b, sigma; horizons [n_h]. DITANYAKAN: E[r_t], sd[r_t], stationary sd, half-life. RUMUS: Card 1: E = b + (r0-b)e^{-at}; Var = sigma^2(1-e^{-2at})/(2a); HL = ln2/a. JAWAB: 1) per horizon. 2) stationary. 3) HL in years (x252 days if asked).

title: Vasicek calibration from short-rate series, exact AR(1)
deliverables: summary json: alpha, beta, a, b, sigma, half_life
frame: DIKETAHUI: rates [T+1] (percent -> decimal), dt = 1/252. DITANYAKAN: a, b, sigma (per year), half-life. RUMUS: Card 2 exact; toolkit ar1_fit(x), ou_from_ar1(a, phi, sigma_e, dt). JAWAB: 1) decimals, sorted. 2) AR(1) on levels. 3) check 0 < beta < 1 else NaN. 4) map. 5) half-life.
pitfalls: beta >= 1 gives no mean reversion: NaN half-life

title: Vasicek calibration, Euler regression on rate changes
deliverables: summary json: a, b, sigma (euler), a_exact
frame: DIKETAHUI: rates [T+1], dt; text names Euler. DITANYAKAN: a = -beta/dt, b = -alpha/beta, sigma = sd(e)/sqrt(dt). RUMUS: Card 2 Euler: dr_t = alpha + beta r_t + e. JAWAB: 1) dr and lagged r. 2) OLS. 3) map. 4) compare exact.

title: Vasicek maximum likelihood estimation
deliverables: summary json: a, b, sigma, loglik
frame: DIKETAHUI: rates [T+1] decimal, dt. DITANYAKAN: MLE parameters and LL. RUMUS: r_{t+dt} | r_t ~ N(b + (r_t-b)e^{-a dt}, sigma^2(1-e^{-2a dt})/(2a)); closed form via OLS with ddof=0. JAWAB: 1) OLS start. 2) LL maximise (multi-start). 3) report LL. 4) check vs AR(1) mapping.
formulas: LL = sum ln phi(r_{t+1}; m_t, v)

title: Vasicek exact simulation and Monte Carlo bond price
frame: DIKETAHUI: r0, a, b, sigma, T, n_steps, n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: MC P(0,T) = E[exp(-int r)] with SE vs closed form. RUMUS: Card 2 exact step; int r by trapezoid; toolkit vasicek_zcb. JAWAB: 1) simulate. 2) integral per path. 3) mean of exp(-I), SE. 4) compare.

title: Vasicek zero-coupon bond option
deliverables: per-contract table: T, S, K, call, put
frame: DIKETAHUI: r0, a, b, sigma; option expiry T, bond maturity S > T, strike K. DITANYAKAN: ZBC, ZBP prices. RUMUS: sp = sigma sqrt((1-e^{-2aT})/(2a)) B(T,S); h = ln(P(0,S)/(P(0,T)K))/sp + sp/2; ZBC = P(0,S)N(h) - K P(0,T)N(h - sp); toolkit vasicek_zcb_option(r0,kappa,theta,sigma,T,S,K,kind). JAWAB: 1) P(0,T), P(0,S). 2) sp, h. 3) prices. 4) check parity ZBC - ZBP = P(0,S) - K P(0,T).

title: Vasicek European swaption via Jamshidian
deliverables: per-contract table: T0, tenor, K, payer, receiver
frame: DIKETAHUI: r0, a, b, sigma; expiry T0, pay times [n], accruals, strike K. DITANYAKAN: Payer and receiver swaption prices. RUMUS: Card 6; toolkit vasicek_swaption(r0,kappa,theta,sigma,T0,pay_times,K,accruals,kind). JAWAB: 1) coupons c_i = K d_i, c_n += 1. 2) solve r* with sum c_i P(T0,T_i,r*) = 1. 3) X_i. 4) payer = sum c_i ZBP. 5) check payer - receiver = swap value.
formulas: payer = sum c_i ZBP(T0, T_i, X_i)
pitfalls: receiver uses ZBC, payer uses ZBP

title: Vasicek caplet as put on zero-coupon bond
deliverables: per-caplet table: T1, T2, caplet, floorlet
frame: DIKETAHUI: r0, a, b, sigma; reset T1, pay T2, accrual d, cap rate K, notional N. DITANYAKAN: Caplet value (currency). RUMUS: Card 5 relation: caplet = N (1 + K d) ZBP(T1, T2, 1/(1+K d)); floorlet = N(1+Kd) ZBC. JAWAB: 1) X = 1/(1+Kd). 2) ZBP via vasicek_zcb_option. 3) scale. 4) check vs Black-implied value plausibility.
formulas: caplet = (1 + K d) ZBP(T1, T2, 1/(1 + K d))

title: Vasicek probability of negative short rate
frame: DIKETAHUI: r0, a, b, sigma, horizons. DITANYAKAN: P(r_t < 0). RUMUS: N(-E[r_t]/sd[r_t]). JAWAB: 1) moments. 2) probability. 3) stationary limit N(-b sqrt(2a)/sigma).

title: Vasicek yield curve shape classification
frame: DIKETAHUI: r0, a, b, sigma. DITANYAKAN: Curve shape and long yield. RUMUS: Card 1; y_inf = b - sigma^2/(2a^2); r0 < y_inf - sigma^2/(4a^2) -> increasing; r0 > y_inf + sigma^2/(2a^2) -> decreasing; else humped. JAWAB: 1) yields on grid. 2) classify by thresholds and by numeric monotonicity. 3) report.

title: Vasicek bond hedge ratio and rate sensitivity
frame: DIKETAHUI: r0, a, b, sigma; two bond maturities tau1, tau2. DITANYAKAN: dP/dr = -B P for each; hedge units of bond 2 per bond 1. RUMUS: Card 1; n = -(B1 P1)/(B2 P2). JAWAB: 1) P, B. 2) sensitivities. 3) hedge ratio. 4) check B(tau) < tau.

title: Vasicek with market price of risk: P vs Q parameters
frame: DIKETAHUI: P-measure a, b, sigma, lambda (market price of risk). DITANYAKAN: Risk-neutral long-run level and bond prices. RUMUS: Under Q: b* = b - lambda sigma/a (sign per text convention); use b* in Card 1. JAWAB: 1) b*. 2) prices. 3) state convention.

title: Vasicek calibration to an observed zero curve
deliverables: summary json: a, b, sigma, r0, rmse
frame: DIKETAHUI: market DFs or zero yields [n] by tau; r0 given or fitted. DITANYAKAN: Parameters minimising squared yield (or price) errors. RUMUS: Card 1 model; L-BFGS-B multi-start. JAWAB: 1) objective. 2) optimise. 3) residuals. 4) check fit and parameter bounds.

title: CIR zero-coupon bond prices and Feller condition
deliverables: table: tau, A, B, price, yield
frame: DIKETAHUI: r0, kappa, theta, sigma; maturities [n]. DITANYAKAN: Prices, yields, Feller ratio 2 kappa theta/sigma^2, long yield. RUMUS: Card 3; toolkit cir_zcb(r0, kappa, theta, sigma, T). JAWAB: 1) g. 2) A, B per tau. 3) P, yields. 4) Feller. 5) long yield 2 kappa theta/(g + kappa). 6) check 0 < P <= 1.

title: CIR exact simulation with noncentral chi-square
deliverables: summary json: mc_mean, theory_mean, mc_bond, closed_form
frame: DIKETAHUI: r0, kappa, theta, sigma, dt, n_steps, n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: Simulated rates and MC bond price vs cir_zcb. RUMUS: Card 4 / V4(a): c = 2kappa/(sigma^2(1-e^{-kappa dt})); r' = ncx2(df = 4kappa theta/sigma^2, nc = 2c r e^{-kappa dt})/(2c). JAWAB: 1) per step draw. 2) integral of r. 3) bond MC, SE. 4) check E[r_t] = theta + (r0-theta)e^{-kappa t}, r >= 0.

title: CIR full-truncation Euler simulation
frame: DIKETAHUI: r0, kappa, theta, sigma, dt, n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: Bond price via full-truncation Euler vs exact. RUMUS: r' = r + kappa(theta - r+)dt + sigma sqrt(r+ dt) Z; use r+ = max(r, 0) in drift, diffusion and discount. JAWAB: 1) simulate. 2) bond MC. 3) compare cir_zcb. 4) bias vs dt.
formulas: r_{t+dt} = r + kappa(theta - r^+)dt + sigma sqrt(r^+) sqrt(dt) Z

title: CIR maximum likelihood with noncentral chi-square density
deliverables: summary json: kappa, theta, sigma, loglik, feller_ratio
frame: DIKETAHUI: rates [T+1] (decimal, positive), dt. DITANYAKAN: MLE parameters and LL. RUMUS: Card 4: log p(r') = ncx2.logpdf(2c r'; df, nc) + ln(2c); OLS/Euler start; bounds positive. JAWAB: 1) start values. 2) neg LL. 3) multi-start L-BFGS-B. 4) report LL, Feller. 5) note bound hits.
formulas: log p = ncx2.logpdf(2 c r') + ln(2 c)

title: CIR calibration to the zero curve
deliverables: summary json: r0, kappa, theta, sigma, rmse
frame: DIKETAHUI: market yields [n] by tau. DITANYAKAN: CIR parameters fitting the curve. RUMUS: Card 3 model prices; minimise yield errors; optional Feller constraint. JAWAB: 1) objective. 2) optimise. 3) residuals. 4) Feller ratio.

title: CIR zero-coupon bond option
frame: DIKETAHUI: r0, kappa, theta, sigma; T, S, K. DITANYAKAN: Call on ZCB under CIR. RUMUS: CIR 1985: ZBC = P(0,S) chi2(2 r* (rho + psi + B(T,S)); 4kappa theta/sigma^2, 2 rho^2 r0 e^{gT}/(rho + psi + B)) - K P(0,T) chi2(2 r*(rho+psi); df, 2 rho^2 r0 e^{gT}/(rho+psi)), rho = 2g/(sigma^2(e^{gT}-1)), psi = (kappa+g)/sigma^2, r* = ln(A(T,S)/K)/B(T,S). JAWAB: 1) A, B. 2) r*. 3) rho, psi. 4) ncx2 cdfs. 5) put by parity. 6) check MC.

title: Hull-White bond price at a future date from the initial curve
frame: DIKETAHUI: DFs [P] by time (curve), a, sigma, t, T, r_t. DITANYAKAN: P(t,T) given r_t. RUMUS: Card 5: B = (1-e^{-a(T-t)})/a; ln A = ln(P(0,T)/P(0,t)) + B f(0,t) - sigma^2(1-e^{-2at})B^2/(4a); toolkit hull_white_zcb(a, sigma, T, curve_fn, t, r_t). JAWAB: 1) log-linear DF interpolation. 2) f(0,t) numeric. 3) A, B. 4) P. 5) check t=0 reproduces market DF.
pitfalls: f(0,t) at a pillar: right-hand forward

title: Hull-White zero-coupon bond option
deliverables: per-contract table: T, S, K, call, put
frame: DIKETAHUI: curve DFs, a, sigma, T, S, K. DITANYAKAN: ZBC, ZBP. RUMUS: Card 5 formulas; toolkit hull_white_zcb_option(a, sigma, T, S, K, curve_fn, kind). JAWAB: 1) P(0,T), P(0,S). 2) sp, h. 3) prices. 4) parity check.

title: Hull-White caplets and cap price
frame: DIKETAHUI: curve DFs, a, sigma, cap schedule [n] (reset, pay, accrual), K, notional. DITANYAKAN: Caplet values and cap total. RUMUS: Card 5: caplet = N(1+Kd) ZBP(T1, T2, 1/(1+Kd)); first (fixed) caplet excluded per V2. JAWAB: 1) schedule. 2) each caplet. 3) sum. 4) check cap - floor = payer swap value.
formulas: caplet_i = N (1 + K d_i) ZBP(T_{i-1}, T_i, 1/(1 + K d_i))

title: Hull-White European swaption via Jamshidian
deliverables: per-contract table: expiry, tenor, strike, payer, receiver
frame: DIKETAHUI: curve DFs, a, sigma, T0, pay times, accruals, K. DITANYAKAN: Swaption prices. RUMUS: Card 6 with HW P(T0,Ti; r) from hull_white_zcb(t=T0, r_t=r) and ZBP from hull_white_zcb_option. JAWAB: 1) coupons. 2) brentq for r*. 3) strikes X_i. 4) sum of bond options. 5) parity.
formulas: payer = sum c_i ZBP(T0, T_i, X_i)

title: Hull-White trinomial tree construction
deliverables: summary: jmax, dx, max DF error
frame: DIKETAHUI: curve DFs, a, sigma, T, n_steps. DITANYAKAN: Tree geometry, probabilities, shifts alpha_m; DF reproduction check. RUMUS: Card 7: dx = sigma sqrt(3dt); jmax = ceil(0.184/(a dt)); M = -a dt; pu, pm, pd normal and edge; forward induction Q; alpha_m = [ln sum_j Q_m(j) e^{-j dx dt} - ln P(0,t_{m+1})]/dt. JAWAB: 1) geometry. 2) probabilities per j. 3) forward induction. 4) alpha. 5) check sum Q_n(j) = P(0,t_n) to 1e-10.
formulas: alpha_m = [ln sum_j Q_m(j)e^{-j dx dt} - ln P(0,t_{m+1})]/dt
pitfalls: edge branching at +-jmax uses different formulas

title: Hull-White tree European bond option vs closed form
frame: DIKETAHUI: built tree, option on ZCB (T, S, K). DITANYAKAN: Tree price vs hull_white_zcb_option. RUMUS: Bond values at T by backward induction from S; option payoff at T; discount back. JAWAB: 1) bond at T nodes. 2) payoff. 3) roll back. 4) compare; check diff -> 0 with steps.
formulas: V_j = e^{-r_j dt} (pu V_up + pm V_mid + pd V_down)

title: Bermudan swaption on a Hull-White tree
frame: DIKETAHUI: tree, exercise dates, swap schedule, K, payer/receiver. DITANYAKAN: Bermudan price and European comparison. RUMUS: At each exercise date swap value from payments strictly after; V = max(exercise, continuation). JAWAB: 1) node swap values. 2) backward induction with exercise. 3) European via Jamshidian. 4) check Bermudan >= European.
pitfalls: including coupon paid at t_k in exercise value

title: Hull-White sigma calibration to caplet or swaption prices
frame: DIKETAHUI: curve, market Black (or normal) vols of instruments [M]; a fixed or fitted. DITANYAKAN: sigma (and a) minimising price errors. RUMUS: Market prices via black_caplet/black_swaption; model prices via Card 5-6. JAWAB: 1) market prices. 2) objective. 3) optimise. 4) residuals.

title: Ho-Lee model as Hull-White with zero mean reversion
frame: DIKETAHUI: curve, sigma, t, T, r_t. DITANYAKAN: Ho-Lee bond prices. RUMUS: B = T - t; ln A = ln(P(0,T)/P(0,t)) + (T-t) f(0,t) - sigma^2 t (T-t)^2/2. JAWAB: 1) B, A. 2) price. 3) check HW with small a converges.
formulas: ln A = ln(P(0,T)/P(0,t)) + B f(0,t) - sigma^2 t B^2/2

title: Hull-White exact Monte Carlo caplet check
frame: DIKETAHUI: curve, a, sigma, caplet T1, T2, K; n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: MC caplet vs analytic. RUMUS: x = r - alpha(t), alpha(t) = f(0,t) + sigma^2(1-e^{-at})^2/(2a^2); x exact OU from 0; discount by integral of r. JAWAB: 1) simulate x, r. 2) at T1 compute P(T1,T2), L. 3) payoff d(L-K)^+ at T2 discounted. 4) SE, compare.

title: Black-76 caplet price
deliverables: per-caplet table: T_fix, T_pay, F, caplet
frame: DIKETAHUI: DFs at dates, K, vol (decimal), accrual d, notional. DITANYAKAN: Caplet value (currency). RUMUS: Card 8; F = (DF(T1)/DF(T2) - 1)/d; toolkit black_caplet(F, K, T, sigma, df, accrual, notional). JAWAB: 1) F. 2) T = fixing time. 3) price with DF(T_pay). 4) check >= 0, increasing in vol.
formulas: caplet = N d DF(T_pay)[F N(d1) - K N(d2)]
pitfalls: payment time in d1 instead of fixing time

title: Black-76 floorlet and floor
frame: DIKETAHUI: schedule, DFs, K, vol(s), notional. DITANYAKAN: Floorlet values and floor. RUMUS: Card 8: floorlet = d DF[K N(-d2) - F N(-d1)]; black_caplet(kind='floorlet'). JAWAB: 1) forwards. 2) floorlets. 3) sum. 4) check positive.
formulas: floorlet = N d DF [K N(-d2) - F N(-d1)]

title: Cap price from flat cap volatility
frame: DIKETAHUI: DFs, cap maturity, frequency, K, flat vol. DITANYAKAN: Cap price = sum of caplets at the flat vol. RUMUS: Card 8 + V2(a): exclude first fixed caplet. JAWAB: 1) schedule. 2) forwards. 3) caplets with flat vol. 4) sum.
pitfalls: T_fix = 0 caplet: intrinsic, divide by zero

title: Cap-floor parity equals payer swap
deliverables: summary json: cap, floor, swap, residual
frame: DIKETAHUI: schedule, DFs, K, vols. DITANYAKAN: Cap - floor and swap value; residual. RUMUS: Card 8: cap - floor = sum d DF (F - K). JAWAB: 1) cap, floor. 2) swap value. 3) residual ~ machine precision.
formulas: Cap - Floor = sum_i d_i DF_i (F_i - K)

title: Caplet volatility stripping from flat cap vols
frame: DIKETAHUI: cap maturities [n] with flat vols, DFs, strike (ATM or fixed). DITANYAKAN: Caplet (forward-forward) vols per period. RUMUS: Card completing: cap_n(flat_n) - cap_{n-1}(flat_{n-1}) = new caplets(sigma_n); solve sequentially. JAWAB: 1) cap prices from flat vols. 2) differences. 3) brentq per new caplet(s). 4) check repricing.

title: Bachelier (normal) caplet price
frame: DIKETAHUI: F, K, T_fix, normal vol (bp -> decimal), DF, d, notional. DITANYAKAN: Caplet value. RUMUS: Card 9; toolkit bachelier_caplet(F, K, T, sigma_n, df, accrual, notional), bachelier_price. JAWAB: 1) bp/10000. 2) x. 3) price. 4) check ATM = d DF s_n sqrt(T/(2pi)).
formulas: caplet = d DF [(F - K)N(x) + s_n sqrt(T) n(x)]
pitfalls: normal vol in a Black formula

title: Converting between Black and normal implied volatilities
frame: DIKETAHUI: F, K, T, one vol type. DITANYAKAN: Equivalent other-type vol giving same price. RUMUS: Price with black76_price/bachelier_price; solve the other vol (brentq); ATM approx s_n ~ s_black F. JAWAB: 1) price. 2) invert. 3) compare approx.

title: Black swaption price and payer-receiver parity
frame: DIKETAHUI: DFs at fixed-leg dates, accruals, T0, K, vol, notional. DITANYAKAN: Prices and parity. RUMUS: Card 10; toolkit swap_rate_and_annuity(dfs, times), black_swaption(F_swap, K, T, sigma, annuity, kind). JAWAB: 1) annuity A. 2) S. 3) prices. 4) payer - receiver = A(S-K).

title: Bachelier swaption price
frame: DIKETAHUI: DFs, schedule, K, normal vol bp, notional. DITANYAKAN: Swaption prices. RUMUS: toolkit bachelier_swaption(F_swap, K, T, sigma_n, annuity, kind). JAWAB: 1) S, A. 2) vol decimal. 3) price. 4) parity.

title: Forward swap rate and annuity from discount factors
frame: DIKETAHUI: DFs at start and fixed dates, accruals. DITANYAKAN: Par forward swap rate and annuity. RUMUS: Card 10; toolkit swap_rate_and_annuity. JAWAB: 1) A. 2) S. 3) check spot-start S = (1 - DF_n)/A.

title: Forward rates from discount factors for caplets
frame: DIKETAHUI: DFs [P], times. DITANYAKAN: Simple forwards per period. RUMUS: F = (DF(T1)/DF(T2) - 1)/d; toolkit forward_rate (continuous) if asked. JAWAB: 1) interpolate DFs log-linearly. 2) forwards. 3) check telescoping sum.

title: Implied Black volatility from a caplet price
frame: DIKETAHUI: caplet price, F, K, T_fix, DF, d. DITANYAKAN: Implied Black vol. RUMUS: brentq on black_caplet(sigma) - price. JAWAB: 1) bracket. 2) solve. 3) reprice check.

title: Shifted lognormal caplet for low or negative rates
frame: DIKETAHUI: F, K, shift s, vol, T, DF, d. DITANYAKAN: Caplet price with Black on F + s, K + s. RUMUS: Card V1(c). JAWAB: 1) shift. 2) Black. 3) check F + s > 0.
formulas: caplet = d DF Black(F + s, K + s)

title: Swaption delta (DV01) and vega
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, A, T, vol. DITANYAKAN: Delta to S, DV01 per 1bp, vega per 1 vol point. RUMUS: Black: delta = A N(d1); vega = A S phi(d1) sqrt(T); DV01 by curve bump. JAWAB: 1) analytic. 2) bump check. 3) check payer DV01 > 0.

title: Cap vega by caplet
frame: DIKETAHUI: schedule, forwards, DFs, vols. DITANYAKAN: Vega per caplet and total. RUMUS: vega = N d DF F phi(d1) sqrt(T_fix). JAWAB: 1) per caplet. 2) sum. 3) bump check.
formulas: vega_i = N d_i DF_i F_i phi(d1) sqrt(T_i)

title: First caplet treatment and intrinsic value
frame: DIKETAHUI: schedule incl. first period, fixed first rate, K. DITANYAKAN: Cap with first caplet excluded (default) and included. RUMUS: V2; first caplet = d DF (L0 - K)^+ (no vol). JAWAB: 1) caplets. 2) both totals. 3) report default.

title: ATM swaption straddle under Bachelier
frame: DIKETAHUI: A, T, normal vol. DITANYAKAN: Payer + receiver at K = S. RUMUS: Straddle = 2 A s_n sqrt(T/(2pi)). JAWAB: 1) formula. 2) check vs sum of prices.

title: Vol type detection from quote magnitude
frame: DIKETAHUI: quoted vols, rate level. DITANYAKAN: Which model to use and vol in decimal. RUMUS: Card conventions: vol ~ 0.5-1.5% of rate level -> normal (bp); 10-60% -> lognormal. JAWAB: 1) magnitude cue. 2) convert. 3) price with matching model.

title: Rate data preparation: percent to decimal and dt basis
frame: DIKETAHUI: rates file [T+1]. DITANYAKAN: Clean decimal series and dt. RUMUS: Card conventions: percent/100; dt = 1/252 (V5). JAWAB: 1) sort, dedupe. 2) convert. 3) dt. 4) proceed.

title: Log-OU with jumps for rates or commodity: forward moments
frame: DIKETAHUI: kappa, theta, sigma, lambda, mu_J, s_J, x0, horizons. DITANYAKAN: Moments of X and E[S]. RUMUS: Card 11. JAWAB: 1) e. 2) E, Var. 3) E[S] = exp(m + v/2).

title: Jump detection on short-rate OU residuals
deliverables: summary json: n_jumps, lambda, mu_J, sigma_J
frame: DIKETAHUI: rates [T+1], dt. DITANYAKAN: Jump flags and stats. RUMUS: |e| > 3 std(e); do not refit unless told. JAWAB: 1) AR(1). 2) flags. 3) stats per year.

title: Vasicek Bermudan or American bond option on a tree
frame: DIKETAHUI: a, b, sigma, r0, tree steps, option terms. DITANYAKAN: Tree price with early exercise. RUMUS: Card 7 tree with constant drift (no curve fit) or HW tree fitted to Vasicek curve. JAWAB: 1) tree. 2) bond values. 3) backward with exercise. 4) check >= European.

title: Cap pricing with term structure of caplet vols
frame: DIKETAHUI: caplet vols per period, DFs, K. DITANYAKAN: Cap price. RUMUS: Card 8 per caplet own vol. JAWAB: 1) forwards. 2) prices. 3) sum.

title: Swaption price per notional and in currency
frame: DIKETAHUI: swaption inputs, notional. DITANYAKAN: Price in currency and bp of notional. RUMUS: Card 10 x notional; bp = price/(N) x 1e4. JAWAB: 1) unit price. 2) scale. 3) report units.

title: Zero-coupon yields and forwards implied by a short-rate model
frame: DIKETAHUI: model parameters, grid. DITANYAKAN: Yields and instantaneous forwards. RUMUS: f(0,T) = -d ln P/dT (numerical); y = -ln P/T. JAWAB: 1) prices. 2) yields. 3) forwards. 4) check telescoping.

title: Short-rate model comparison: Vasicek vs CIR fit
deliverables: summary json: ll_vasicek, ll_cir, aic each, preferred
frame: DIKETAHUI: rates [T+1], dt. DITANYAKAN: MLE for both, AIC. RUMUS: Gaussian vs ncx2 likelihoods. JAWAB: 1) fit both. 2) AIC = 2k - 2LL. 3) choose.

title: Payer swap value and DV01 from curve
frame: DIKETAHUI: DFs, K, schedule, notional. DITANYAKAN: Swap value and DV01. RUMUS: V = N A (S - K); DV01 by parallel 1bp bump. JAWAB: 1) A, S. 2) value. 3) bump.
